en: Black‑and‑white view down a gently rising cobblestone street in a historic European town. Two‑ and three‑story houses with steep tiled roofs line both sides of the street, many with shop signs in German painted on their facades. People in early 20th‑century clothing, including children, are walking or standing in the street, and a horse‑drawn cart is visible. In the background, a large Gothic‑style church with a tall tower and spire dominates the skyline. In the foreground is a small staircase with iron railings and a fenced garden area.
